pr_title: fix(tracing): do not stall on dialogs

issue_context.title: [BUG] Dialogs cannot be dismissed if tracing is on in Chromium or Webkit
comments: I wonder if our blocking snapshotter is waiting for dialog. Looking into it, will likely get a fix in a patch.
Thanks for the quick fix! Much appreciated.

review_comments: Do we have to catch this promise and await it? I am worried that `dialog.accept` will race with `context.close` and throw an unhandled promise rejection.
I believe we are ok since the following call to confirm is blocking and is serialized with the accept ack.
